name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 28 times in 9 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 56 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-10-30, at wavelengths from 1.13 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
